usedFor: Shopify holds the store and Google Sheets is where the team keeps its own tallies. “New Order” can run “Add New Row to Sheet”, giving you a running list you can filter and share.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every sale becomes one row the moment it happens, and a sheet is the simplest place to add your own columns, such as who packed it.

watchOut: “New Customer” can also run “Add New Row to Sheet”, so sending both into one sheet mixes orders and customers. Use a separate sheet for each.
